metadata.description: Local text to textured GLB, plus humanoid rigging and clips, on an AMD Strix Halo iGPU

plugins.name: text-to-3d
plugins.description: Turns one subject description into a textured GLB on a Strix Halo iGPU, and rigs a generated humanoid with a Mixamo-named skeleton and playable clips. The skill initializes ComfyUI, a resident Vulkan TRELLIS.2 engine, a SkinTokens rig service on ROCm, and the local preview gallery.
